areas.evidence: Exact embedding of 1x1/1x3/3x1/identity audited; independent fp64 probe peaked 9.95e-14 against a 1e-12 bound; injected mutants rejected.
Zero-padding border equality checked explicitly, not just interior; 20 integer-valued cases bitwise equal.
Branch bias summation audited; bias=None is unsupported but has no constructor or callsite path.
No BatchNorm was introduced. The registered ladder is linear-branch only; the BN experiment was conditional and never run.
71 fusion tests; worst branch-vs-fused 1.19e-6 float32, 7.2e-16 in float64 after the dtype fix.
Export round-trips bit-exactly through real JSON text; 17 models carry 6,291 deployed weights and no branch tensors.
Nine artifact-linked models verified in Chrome on apple/metal-3, f32 stage max 1.41e-6, f16 max 5.67e-3, file hashes re-checked before dispatch.
Amendment chronology verified against git timestamps; every amendment predates the evidence it governs.
Tie rule, clip-first metric and the 3-seed permutation floor implemented as registered; withdrawn pilot cannot produce a selection.
